ON THE 19 th OF JUNE, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 22571 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 SHIVKUMAR JHARIYA S/O SHRI RAMKARAN JHARIYA,
 AGED ABOUT 50 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 AGRICULTURIST RESIDENT OF VILLAGE KARANJIYA  POST RAJO TAHSIL BICHHIYA DISTRICT MANDLA  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MAYANK SHARMA-ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION KARANJIYA DISTRICT DINDORI (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI PRAMOD THAKRE-PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:
 ORDER

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.97/2023 dated 29.04.2023 registered at Police Station-Karanjiya, District-Dindori (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376(2)(n), 366, 294,
506/34 of IPC.
Applicant apprehending his arrest in the aforesaid offences has knocked the portal of this Court for grant of anticipatory bail.
As per the prosecution story, on 27.04.2023 27 year old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing before police alleging that in 2022 she met Shakti Jhariya S/o Shiv Kumar Jhariya.
He told her that he likes her and wanted to enter into wedlock with her.

1 16.03.2022 he forcibly established physical relation with her and thereafter established physical relations with her on 07.08.2022, 26.08.2022, 04.09.2022 and 15.09.2022.

sentences.text: Lastly he established such relation on 13.10.2022.
Now he refused to marry with her and is also not talking with her.
On 11.04.2023, she made an oral complaint against him to his father Shiv Kumar Jhariya who abused her and drove her out of the home and threatened to defame and eliminate her.
FIR was registered.
Investigation is under way.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
There is no allegation of committing rape against the applicant.
The only allegation against him is that he being the father of main accused Shakti Jhariya drove away the prosecutrix from his home and threatened her.
Applicant is a Government servant.
There is no possibility of his fleeing from justice.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant be released on anticipatory bail.
O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of anticipatory bail.
I have gone through the case diary and material available on record.
Main allegations are against Shakti Jhariya who is son of the present applicant.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the entirety of the allegations made against the present applicant, I am of the view that it is a case in which custodial interrogation of the present applicant is not warranted.
Consequently, this first anticipatory bail application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant stands allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest applicant-Shivkumar Jhariya be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigation Officer.

At stage of filing of charge-sheet by police, applicant shall furnish fresh bail bond of same amount before committal Court/trial Court to its satisfaction subject to following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall make himself available for interrogation before Investigation officer as and when required.
He shall join investigation then and there and shall fully cooperate in investigation.

(ii) Applicant shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
(iii) I n case, applicant is not arrested within a period of 8 days from today by the Investigation Officer, he himself shall surrender before the Investigation Officer within 10 (Ten) days from today failing which this order shall become ineffective.

However, it is being made clear that in case of bail jump and in violation of any of conditions imposed herein above, this order shall become ineffective and Investigation Officer shall be at liberty to proceed against the applicant as per law.
